events.name: Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix 2026 (first SG Sprint weekend)
events.attendees: 260,000+ over race weekend, large international share
events.rationale: Night race plus Singapore's first F1 Sprint; concerts by The Killers and Lana Del Rey. Historically the strongest citywide compression weekend of the year — international adults staying 3-5 nights in/near CBD.
events.best_fit: All sectors — The Quays and City Hall closest to circuit; Chinatown and Kampong Glam overflow

events.name: TOKEN2049 Singapore
events.rationale: Crypto's largest global gathering, deliberately scheduled into F1 week; back-to-back with the GP it creates a 5-6 night compression block Oct 6-12. Attendees are international adult professionals with strong side-event activity across CBD shophouse districts.
events.best_fit: Chinatown and The Quays (CBD proximity, side events); City Hall

events.name: The Weeknd — After Hours Til Dawn Tour
events.attendees: ~50,000 per night, two nights, significant regional fly-in
events.rationale: Stadium-scale international act; past comparable stadium shows (Coldplay, Taylor Swift, Lady Gaga) drove regional fly-in fans staying 1-2 nights. Adult-skewing audience fits adults-only positioning.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang); The Quays

events.name: National Stadium concert weekend — Stray Kids / Post Malone
events.attendees: ~50,000 per show, strong regional fly-in (K-pop + international touring act)
events.rationale: Two stadium-scale acts listed for the same weekend; K-pop stadium shows in Singapore reliably pull SEA fly-in fans who stay overnight. Mostly young adults — fits adults-only properties.
events.best_fit: Kampong Glam and City Hall (closest to Kallang)

events.name: ITB Asia 2026 (with co-located travel-tech events)
events.rationale: Asia's leading travel trade show; multi-day international delegate base staying 3-4 nights, historically converts into CBD midscale occupancy.
events.best_fit: Chinatown and The Quays; City Hall

events.name: Singapore IP Week 2026
events.venue: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre
events.rationale: Government-anchored professional conference; international delegates stay 2-3 nights but total room-night volume is modest versus flagship shows.

events.name: Asian Actuarial Conference 2026
events.venue: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention Centre
events.rationale: Four-day professional conference with international delegates staying most of the week; small volume but long length-of-stay, adult business travellers.

events.name: BEX Asia 2026 (Built Environment Week)
events.rationale: Established regional construction/built-environment trade show; meaningful but partly local/day-attendee audience, so moderate room-night conversion.

events.name: Submarine Networks World 2026
events.rationale: Niche but highly international two-day conference; delegates fly in and stay near CBD. Small volume caps impact at moderate.
